review_comment_summary: Implementation Work index copied global likely_code_refs into every per-spec work item, which could over-scope coding agents.
fix_summary: Added per-spec likely_affected_code_refs_by_spec in the delta snapshot and scoped work item code refs from that map.

review_comment_summary: Malformed implementation delta snapshots could crash when target was not an object.
fix_summary: Added explicit target type validation before work-index field access.

review_comment_summary: Implementation delta status ignored policy flags that made missing trace/evidence baselines non-blocking.
fix_summary: Derived readiness now honors blocks_on_missing_trace and blocks_on_missing_evidence policy flags.

review_comment_summary: AGENTS.md introduced absolute local markdown links that would be broken outside one workstation.
fix_summary: Replaced local absolute links with repository-relative links and added a regression assertion against /Users markdown links.

review_comment_summary: The policy allowed accepted risk as a closure path but did not make the residual-risk requirement explicit enough.
fix_summary: Added an explicit accepted_risk_action contract and test coverage that accepted risk requires residual risk recording.

review_comment_summary: Required string fields could pass validation when JSON records used null or non-string values because str(None) produced a non-blank value.
fix_summary: Added strict required-string validation with invalid_field_type and blank_required_field findings for non-string required closure fields.

review_comment_summary: Non-list verification values produced verification_must_be_list findings but were classified as missing_verification, sending the wrong next_gap.
fix_summary: Prioritized invalid contract findings before missing-field statuses so non-list verification becomes invalid_feedback_record.

review_comment_summary: The policy test required review_feedback_records.json to be non-empty even though an empty list is a valid artifact state.
fix_summary: Removed the non-empty assertion while keeping vocabulary validation for any records that are present.

review_comment_summary: Accepted-risk review-feedback follow-ups were visible as review_* next gaps and therefore became immediate ready_for_review, high-priority backlog items.
fix_summary: Special-cased accepted_risk_recorded review-feedback follow-ups so they remain visible as info-priority items without entering the urgent ready_for_review filter.

review_comment_summary: Dashboard review-feedback named filters used keys that did not match the backlog projection filter names, breaking dashboard-to-backlog drill-down expectations.
fix_summary: Aligned dashboard named filter keys with backlog projection keys: review_feedback_invalid and review_feedback_accepted_risk.

review_comment_summary: Legacy implementation_work_index artifacts without implementation_backlog.items could produce dashboard counts while adding no normalized graph backlog rows.
fix_summary: Added compatibility normalization when loading existing implementation work indexes, rebuilding backlog items from entries or grouped legacy next-gap data.

review_comment_summary: Transition packet validation summary output kept only finding_count, losing the actual findings on non-zero validation failures.
fix_summary: Preserved findings and findings_by_family in transition_packet_validation summary output.

review_comment_summary: --output-mode help text said standalone artifact commands even though the implementation also affects graph-health observation JSON output.
fix_summary: Updated argparse help to describe JSON-emitting supervisor commands and compact diagnostic summaries.

review_comment_summary: Graph-health observation summary mode omitted the detailed graph_health observations that operators use for diagnosis.
fix_summary: Kept the full graph_health diagnostic payload and observation_count in graph_health_observation summary output.

review_comment_summary: Changing default supervisor reasoning from xhigh to medium removed post-timeout quiet/progress grace from default child runs.
fix_summary: Allowed medium reasoning to use the same quiet/progress grace windows as xhigh and added parameterized regression coverage.

review_comment_summary: SG-SPEC-0043 updated_at reflected the 2026-04-27 refinement, but last_gate_at still pointed to an older approval timestamp.
fix_summary: Refreshed SG-SPEC-0043 last_gate_at so the approved gate timestamp no longer predates the current contents.
residual_risk: A repository-wide timestamp freshness validator is intentionally deferred because many legacy spec nodes still carry older last_gate_at values; this PR fixes only the reviewed SG-SPEC-0043 drift.
accepted_risk_review_summary: Revalidated after later process-rule-gap feedback. The repository-wide timestamp freshness validator remains intentionally deferred because legacy nodes still violate the timestamp relation; the accepted risk should stay in watch state instead of blocking next-move selection.

review_comment_summary: Proposal 0040 used inline status text that parse_proposal_document would not treat as machine-readable proposal status.
fix_summary: Converted the inline status line into a parseable ## Status section and verified proposal_runtime_index reports status Draft proposal for 0040.

review_comment_summary: Proposal 0040 introduced a new --branch-rewrite-root selector instead of reusing the supervisor's existing --target-spec selector.
fix_summary: Changed the proposal command and input contract to use --target-spec as the branch root selector.

review_comment_summary: Proposal 0040 nested canonical_mutations_allowed and tracked_artifacts_written under mutation_boundary, unlike existing derived artifact contracts.
fix_summary: Moved canonical_mutations_allowed and tracked_artifacts_written to top-level fields in the output contract example.

review_comment_summary: Proposal 0040 defined preview_status values without specifying corresponding review_state and next_gap behavior for blocked states.
fix_summary: Added an explicit Status Mapping section that maps ready, no-candidate, invalid, too-large, unresolved-gate, broken-reference, and empty-branch statuses to review_state and next_gap values.

review_comment_summary: Proposal 0040 required review evidence such as source graph version and inspected edges but did not show where those fields live in the output contract.
fix_summary: Added provenance and review_evidence fields to the output contract and mapped each review-boundary evidence requirement to those fields.

review_comment_summary: The graph backlog viewer contract recommended returning raw artifact JSON while also asking viewers to show file mtime, unlike the envelope pattern used by other viewer endpoints.
fix_summary: Updated the endpoint contract to return the standard viewer metadata envelope with path, mtime, mtime_iso, and the unmodified artifact under data.

review_comment_summary: Branch rewrite preview accepted historical lineage nodes as roots even though the mode is scoped to active refines subtrees.
fix_summary: Added a non-active root guard that returns invalid_root with blocked review evidence when the requested root is historical.

review_comment_summary: Branch rewrite preview loaded policy-declared preview_status and review_state vocabularies but did not validate generated artifacts against them.
fix_summary: Added branch rewrite status contract validation and regression coverage for invalid preview_status and mapped review_state drift.

review_comment_summary: Branch rewrite subtree traversal used list pop(0), making FIFO traversal O(n^2) if subtree policy limits grow.
fix_summary: Switched branch rewrite traversal to collections.deque with popleft while preserving traversal behavior.

review_comment_summary: Historical candidate classification could be overwritten by later bookkeeping or topology-prose heuristics.
fix_summary: Made historical candidate handling mutually exclusive so historical lineage keeps deemphasize_historical_lineage as the suggested action.

review_comment_summary: Graph next-moves loading coerced branch rewrite preview candidate_count and node_count with int(), so malformed local generated artifacts could crash viewer-surface refresh instead of producing repair guidance.
fix_summary: Added safe non-negative integer parsing for branch rewrite preview summary counts and converted invalid count fields into a malformed source artifact state that recommends repair_source_artifact.

review_comment_summary: Spec activity feed skipped review-feedback commits when no SG-SPEC id could be inferred from the commit subject or changed paths.
fix_summary: Preserved unscoped review-feedback activity as graph-level process events with empty spec_id and added regression coverage.

review_comment_summary: The spec activity feed viewer contract listed viewer_contract as stable but omitted it from the expected JSON shape example.
fix_summary: Updated the expected artifact shape example to include the viewer_contract object written by the builder.

review_comment_summary: The repository static artifact publishing guidance listed the local-only follow-up proposal draft candidate, but the corresponding DocC ArtifactPublishing page omitted that artifact and exclusion guarantee.
fix_summary: Synchronized the DocC ArtifactPublishing page with the local-only follow-up proposal draft candidate artifact and Make target.

review_comment_summary: The follow-up proposal draft candidate validator did not compare privacy_boundary values with the contract, so tampered local-only/public-publish flags could pass validation.
fix_summary: Added privacy-boundary validation for follow-up proposal draft candidates and regression coverage for tampered privacy flags.

review_comment_summary: The follow-up proposal draft candidate validator checked source_request_status but not summary.source_request_state before treating a candidate as ready.
fix_summary: Required ready candidates to preserve an allowed source_request_state and added regression coverage for blocked request state tampering.

review_comment_summary: The follow-up proposal draft candidate validator did not reject tampered promotion.writes_proposal_markdown or promotion.writes_proposal_registry flags.
fix_summary: Extended promotion boundary validation to reject proposal markdown and registry write flags, with regression coverage for both tampered fields.

review_comment_summary: A no-successor withdrawn Requirement had no explicit presence transition and could remain active for traversal, readiness, and dependency satisfaction.
fix_summary: The review packet distinguishes subject retirement from canonical graph topology: its BDD withdrawal example keeps historical lookup and unchanged node traversal while excluding the retired Requirement from readiness and dependency satisfaction.
residual_risk: The packet records recommendations and BDD examples for the proposed child; it does not change canonical runtime behavior or topology.

review_comment_summary: The typed decomposition and composition relations excluded acceptance criteria even though the proposal's motivating scope and consumer mapping included criterion split and composition.
fix_summary: The review packet extends both directed subject relations to Requirements and acceptance criteria, requires same-kind endpoints, preserves all directed participants, and includes a BDD example rejecting cross-kind composition.
residual_risk: The packet is a review recommendation; it does not add runtime relation validation.

review_comment_summary: A second 0221 Markdown slug in docs/proposals caused the existing proposal ID allocator to block subsequent allocations.
fix_summary: Moved the adoption discussion packet to docs/reviews, outside the numbered proposal namespace. The existing make proposal-id validator now reports ready with next ID 0222 and zero blockers; no validator change is claimed.
residual_risk: Future numbered proposal documents must continue to use unique IDs and slugs in docs/proposals; the existing allocator check remains the verification path.

review_comment_summary: A successor identity's first revision had a cross-identity supersession predecessor but no same-identity predecessor, conflicting with the per-identity origin and chain requirements.
fix_summary: The review packet defines revision 1 as the origin of each identity sequence and treats the SG-SPEC-0019 cross-identity predecessor_reference as a separate supersession link, with a BDD example asserting the separation.
residual_risk: The packet records a proposed contract and example; it does not implement or validate revision-chain runtime behavior.

review_comment_summary: The report checked the current PR head against a later fetched head but did not bind it to the SHA that had passed the triggering Python CI run.
fix_summary: The workflow now carries workflow_run.head_sha and skips reporting unless both the API head and fetched pull ref equal that tested SHA.
residual_risk: A newer push requires its own successful Python CI run before it receives an updated metrics comment.

review_comment_summary: A pre-integration source snapshot may not contain the scopes directory required by the trusted metric manifest copy.
fix_summary: The workflow creates the per-snapshot scopes directory before copying the trusted manifest; a regression test asserts the ordering.
residual_risk: The workflow continues to rely on the checked-out trusted default branch for metric configuration.

review_comment_summary: A truthy scalar or list candidate_approval_decision_ref was incorrectly interpreted as a materialized decision.
fix_summary: The classifier now requires a nonempty mapping and regression tests cover strings, lists, booleans, empty mappings, and a valid mapping.
residual_risk: The reference remains a mapping-level contract; its internal identifier semantics are not validated here.

review_comment_summary: After classifier extraction, the base-ref metric could read zero-branch compatibility wrappers from the old report instead of the classifier modules present at that ref.
fix_summary: Base metrics now come from registered classifier modules and PredicateSpec lambdas whenever present, with per-decision legacy fallback only when the module is absent; a Git-backed regression test proves parity on an extracted baseline.
residual_risk: Pre-extraction refs still use legacy function bodies because classifier modules do not yet exist there.

review_comment_summary: LAC007 recognized context artifact accessor methods but missed protected reads through c.artifacts[...] and c.artifacts.get(...).
fix_summary: The source gate now recognizes direct literal-key subscript and get access on typed context roots and predicate contexts; tests assert both findings.
residual_risk: Dynamic artifact keys and indirect container aliases are outside this static gate's recognized forms.

review_comment_summary: Base role totals included branch_points_total but omitted predicate_lambda_count and predicate_lambda_branch_points that each classifier baseline already measured.
fix_summary: Base aggregation now sums the same three decision metric fields as the head snapshot; a regression test compares all three totals for an extracted baseline.
residual_risk: The aggregate remains limited to the metric fields defined by the lifecycle report contract.

review_comment_summary: Unavailable decision metrics were excluded from source_kinds, allowing a partial baseline to be labeled as a complete state_classifier baseline.
fix_summary: The report now selects complete baseline roles only when every decision has metrics and labels any partial result incomplete; a regression test covers a missing historical symbol.
residual_risk: Unavailable historical decisions remain visible with null metrics and an incomplete top-level baseline role.

review_comment_summary: Base-source lookup used the head policy module path, so module moves could miss the registered historical classifier and fall back to an obsolete wrapper.
fix_summary: The baseline now loads and validates the lifecycle policy at base_ref, matches decisions by stable ID, and resolves the historical module path and symbol; a Git-backed regression test covers a renamed module.
residual_risk: Refs predating the lifecycle policy file retain the compatibility path based on the current policy and legacy function fallback.

review_comment_summary: Digest corruption survived into the foreign workspace check, allowing false positive identity rejection evidence.
fix_summary: Restore candidate bytes in finally and assert selected workspace content before testing foreign identity.
residual_risk: Local HTTP evidence does not prove production publication.

review_comment_summary: Acceptance reference ordering made equivalent replicas ambiguous.
fix_summary: Normalize unordered acceptance collections in typed revisions, with equivalent normalization for revision and endpoint presentation. Regression: test_replicas_coalesce_when_acceptance_reference_order_differs.
residual_risk: Identical replica policy still rejects actual content divergence and replica lag.

review_comment_summary: The snapshot could retain only the current disposition and discarded earlier authored transitions.
fix_summary: Store and return immutable retained_disposition_transitions with unique event references and provenance; reject contradiction with a retained current basis event. Regression: test_disposition_history_is_retained_without_inferring_current_or_as_of_state.
residual_risk: Event ordering, as-of lookup and history completeness are not inferred; writers remain deferred.

review_comment_summary: One dataset identity could declare multiple immutable workspace identities.
fix_summary: Detect reused dataset identities across workspace declarations and fail every affected scope closed. Regression: test_one_dataset_cannot_declare_multiple_workspace_identities.
residual_risk: Workspace and dataset declarations remain supplied metadata, not verified authority.

review_comment_summary: The closed physical Requirement schema omitted SG-SPEC-0024 node provenance and could not represent canonical actor, time and inferred confidence.
fix_summary: Retain the structured envelope in Requirement revisions and current projections, with required and conditional metadata and explicit null candidate adoption fields. Regression: test_requirement_provenance_retains_the_governing_node_envelope.
residual_risk: Physical schema remains pending human approval; the canonical-source adapter and validating writer are not implemented. Candidate fixture checks do not prove writer enforcement or adoption.

review_comment_summary: The closed revision schema omitted the bounded revision_scope required by SG-SPEC-0019 and SG-SPEC-0068.
fix_summary: Require and retain an authored bounded revision_scope in every Requirement and criterion revision, including proposed origins. Regression: test_revision_scope_is_authored_for_every_proposed_origin.
residual_risk: Physical schema remains pending human approval; the canonical-source adapter and validating writer are not implemented. Candidate fixture checks do not prove writer enforcement or adoption.

review_comment_summary: Exact case-sensitive IDs were treated as automatically safe distinct filenames on case-insensitive filesystems.
fix_summary: Preserve exact identity while rejecting workspace-wide ASCII case collision keys at allocation, publication and whole-tree source validation across classes, groups and disposition. Regression: test_case_aliases_collide_across_classes_and_grouping.
residual_risk: Physical schema remains pending human approval; the canonical-source adapter and validating writer are not implemented. Candidate fixture checks do not prove writer enforcement or adoption.

review_comment_summary: The pending physical schema introduced activate/withdraw aliases without specifying translation to the existing activation/withdrawal typed vocabulary.
fix_summary: Use activation and withdrawal directly in the pending storage schema. Regression: test_disposition_vocabulary_matches_the_typed_model; no current source-adapter runtime regression is claimed.
residual_risk: Physical schema remains pending human approval; the canonical-source adapter and validating writer are not implemented. Candidate fixture checks do not prove writer enforcement or adoption.

review_comment_summary: Normalized scenario digest lacked canonical fields, serialization, text policy and versioned hash semantics.
fix_summary: Make a reviewed canonical byte contract with explicit field/text/encoding/hash/version/domain-separation decisions and cross-adapter fixtures a prerequisite before activation or normalized binding. Future BDD-14; no runtime serializer added.
residual_risk: Contract preparation only. Native/exchange fixtures, activation and writer enforcement are separate work; documentation gates do not execute these scenarios or establish trusted evidence. GitHub thread state must be checked separately.

review_comment_summary: Minimal native scenarios could not preserve Feature metadata, scoped tags or file comments during Gherkin round-trip.
fix_summary: Proposal 0.1.1 defines bdd_scenario_exchange_envelope schema/version/bindings, current payload digest, origin provenance, Feature/Scenario metadata, direct ID tags and ordered file comments. Future BDD-05/11/12; no exchange runtime added.
residual_risk: Contract preparation only. Native/exchange fixtures, activation and writer enforcement are separate work; documentation gates do not execute these scenarios or establish trusted evidence. GitHub thread state must be checked separately.

review_comment_summary: Applying an authorized migration preview lacked a source-digest precondition and could overwrite a source changed after preview review.
fix_summary: Require the exact reviewed preview and all input bindings/source pins to match at the serialized mutation boundary before writing; stale-preview means no source writes. Protect check/publication against concurrent edits and validate the staged candidate. Future BDD-13; writer enforcement remains future work.
residual_risk: Contract preparation only. Native/exchange fixtures, activation and writer enforcement are separate work; documentation gates do not execute these scenarios or establish trusted evidence. GitHub thread state must be checked separately.

review_comment_summary: Ingress templates omitted mandatory motivating Intent lineage.
fix_summary: Added unresolved lineage fields and blockers; forbids guessed lineage and in-place template approval.
residual_risk: Intent lineage is unresolved and genuine decisions are absent. Governed decision-to-request gate remains unimplemented; no materialization is authorized.

review_comment_summary: Generic DocC term matching did not bind this packet digest.
fix_summary: Published exact revised scope digest in DocC and require it in the sync contract and focused regression.
residual_risk: Intent lineage is unresolved and genuine decisions are absent. Governed decision-to-request gate remains unimplemented; no materialization is authorized.

review_comment_summary: CI checked surface markers without recomputing packet and input hashes.
fix_summary: Added a CI validator and mutation tests covering complete inputs, paired transitions and pending authority boundaries.
residual_risk: Intent lineage is unresolved and genuine decisions are absent. Governed decision-to-request gate remains unimplemented; no materialization is authorized.

review_comment_summary: Partial equality omitted status, authority, node provenance, containment and disposition from reviewed candidate binding.
fix_summary: Reuse the complete_reviewed_record SpecificationCore policy for canonical JSON scope equality of all candidate fields; later publication approval cannot replace packet review.
residual_risk: Covered by tests/test_subject_publication.py::test_late_approval_cannot_replace_complete_reviewed_record. Recorded attribution remains un-attested; production lineage and materialization decisions are unresolved.

review_comment_summary: Inventoried declaration was resolved but its content was not compared with the bootstrap request.
fix_summary: Apply the same complete_reviewed_record policy to the full workspace declaration; reject a late allocation/provenance replacement.
residual_risk: Covered by tests/test_subject_publication.py::test_late_allocation_cannot_replace_reviewed_declaration. Recorded attribution remains un-attested; production lineage and materialization decisions are unresolved.

review_comment_summary: Evidence-selection parsing escaped as generic invalid_input instead of the governance failure contract.
fix_summary: Normalize selection parsing, SHA validation and file I/O failures to PublicationGovernanceError; preserve invalid_input for malformed requests.
residual_risk: Covered by tests/test_subject_publication.py::test_cli_classifies_selection_failures_as_governance_blocked. Recorded attribution remains un-attested; production lineage and materialization decisions are unresolved.

review_comment_summary: Checking only the existence of the proposed catalog can land malformed configuration that poisons every subsequent base-catalog check.
fix_summary: Independently validate the future catalog against the effective head snapshot before retaining base-catalog authority for the change comparison.
residual_risk: Catalog migration still requires explicit reviewed rollout; validation does not approve semantic equivalence.
prevention_path: tests/test_rule_reuse_ci.py::test_bad_future_catalog_fails_before_base_comparison; real analyzer rejects malformed future TOML before producing comparison report.

review_comment_summary: Raw PR-head analysis misreads later base-side additions as deletions and can reject otherwise valid merges.
fix_summary: Analyze the GitHub merge result after binding its parents to the event base and PR head; retain all three revisions in comparison.json.
residual_risk: A stale or mismatched GitHub merge snapshot fails closed and needs a new CI run.
prevention_path: tests/test_rule_reuse_ci.py::test_stale_branch_uses_valid_merge_result_containing_base_catalog; test_merge_from_other_pr_is_rejected_before_analysis; real analyzer verifies enforcing merge-result comparison.

review_comment_summary: Working-tree fixture bytes could be attributed to a committed source revision.
fix_summary: Load the fixture from the same recorded Git revision as the remaining snapshot files, preserving exact text bytes.
residual_risk: The regression simulates only the external gate; real analyzer matching is covered separately by the enforcing smoke run.

review_comment_summary: The proposal named correlation between rule evaluations and assertions but lacked an explicit cross-tree edge identity.
fix_summary: Added stable attempt-scoped correlation_id edges from evaluation to assertion, with relation, obligation binding, closure inclusion, and rejection of dangling/conflicting edges.
residual_risk: Runtime realization and admission conformance remain deferred; the contract documents these as future obligations and does not claim implemented behavior.

residual_risk: Runtime realization and admission conformance remain deferred; the contract documents these as future obligations and does not claim implemented behavior.

review_comment_summary: A passing test root could be projected against declared targets without successful target-bound assertions.
fix_summary: Specified fail-closed target verification: each verified target needs a completed successful bound assertion plus required correlations and artifacts; a root pass alone verifies none.
residual_risk: Runtime realization and admission conformance remain deferred; the contract documents these as future obligations and does not claim implemented behavior.
prevention_path: CTX-08a and synchronized DocC name the prevention contract; manual contract review and proposal/DocC gates passed.

review_comment_summary: Finalization could publish success before an attributed asynchronous assertion failure arrived, leaving projected evidence valid.
fix_summary: Required open scope leases to delay finalization and higher attempt-local revisions to invalidate prior success when attributed failures arrive late; consumers must honor the latest revision.
residual_risk: Runtime realization and admission conformance remain deferred; the contract documents these as future obligations and does not claim implemented behavior.

review_comment_summary: The pilot description implied an admission path unavailable to producer observations and the current tests_verified evaluator.
fix_summary: Separated producer-observation inspection from future admission and listed issuance, pinned receipt, policy, trust-store, aggregate decision, and test evaluator as prerequisites.
residual_risk: Runtime realization and admission conformance remain deferred; the contract documents these as future obligations and does not claim implemented behavior.
prevention_path: CTX-10a and synchronized DocC state the unavailable boundary; manual contract review and proposal/DocC gates passed.

review_comment_summary: An unrelated proposal 0221 registry note was rewritten from JSON Unicode escapes to literal Cyrillic, creating audit noise and merge-conflict risk.
fix_summary: Restored the existing escaped Unicode representation and retained only the new 0225 registry entry.
residual_risk: Large append-only registries remain susceptible to broad serializer rewrites if future changes do not preserve existing byte-level formatting.
prevention_path: Review correction restores the prior escaped encoding; future registry edits must preserve unrelated entries byte-for-byte and use targeted insertions.

review_comment_summary: Fresh snapshots of caller-supplied evidence cannot establish that no later attempt revision or late-failure invalidation was omitted.
fix_summary: Made an authority-backed live per-attempt head/finality or revocation proof a hard prerequisite; caller-supplied closure alone cannot prove latest revision. Added TV-14.
residual_risk: The upstream authority contract is not implemented by this proposal; tests_verified remains unavailable until it supplies the required latest-revision proof.
prevention_path: Proposal 0225 acceptance case TV-14 and synchronized DocC describe the authority-backed freshness prerequisite.

review_comment_summary: The admission summary could imply that trusted receipt acceptance alone yields a claim verdict, omitting the separate trusted accepted aggregate decision.
fix_summary: Updated the public admission summary and DocC to require accepted receipt pairs plus a separately verified live trusted accepted aggregate decision under the decision trust store. Added TV-15.
residual_risk: No evaluator is implemented; this review correction clarifies the future contract without enabling admission.
prevention_path: Synchronized admission summary, proposal and DocC explicitly separate receipt-pair validation from aggregate claim decision.

review_comment_summary: A source commit pin alone could be paired with results from a cached or separately built older application/test bundle.
fix_summary: Required exact tested application/build and test bundle identities, digests and source provenance; added fail-closed acceptance case TV-13.
residual_risk: No build-provenance adapter exists in this proposal; implementations must leave evidence unknown until they can establish the binding.
prevention_path: Proposal 0225 acceptance case TV-13 requires tested-build provenance and rejects source/build mismatches.
